title: Rick Probable NDE 4226
content: In my near death experience, I was standing in my family's cemetery. Everyone in the cemetery is a relative of mine. The graves date back to 1869. I saw a number of my dead relatives standing around me; however, none of them could see me. In this experience, there were no tombstones in the cemetery. Some of the people that I saw there died before I was born, yet I am able to describe their mannerisms. I walked through the crowd of dead relatives, and noticed that they were looking in one direction, as if they were waiting for a car to arrive. I realized that they could not see me even when I walked right beside some of them. I decided to leave the scene because I felt that I was not the person that they were looking for. When I woke up, I was being run down the hall of a hospital on a stretcher.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Illness 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' I was dying of a terminal illness. I have had full blown AIDS and I had a viral load that had skyrocketed.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | A landscape or city | Vision of the future
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Towards the end of the experience when I noticed that no one could see me.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I just visited my family cemetery
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I saw my aunt looking for her husband. He died shortly after this experience. I also saw my great-grandmother looking for someone. My grandmother died within a few weeks.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Uncertain After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes It replays in my head over and over and when I want to speak of this event I can't seem to find the right words.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I have never had piano lessons; however, a few weeks after the experience I sat down at the piano and started playing classical music as if I had been playing the piano for years.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Based on some of the actions of the people that I saw there. I was alerted to the fact that my uncle and my grandmother were about to die. They both died within a few months of this experience.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I shared it with others a few months after it happened. My mother was shocked because I very accurately described some of the relatives who died before I was born.
